ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a “schematic diagram of the daily variation of solar altitude on two days of a certain month in a certain place in China.” Read the figure and answer: <image1> When the sun rises at this place on the 1st of this month, what proportion of the world is approximately within the range of the 1st?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the vertical axis is solar altitude, and the horizontal axis is Beijing time; the horizontal axis is marked with 0, 2, 4...24 o’clock. There are two daily variation curves of solar altitude in the figure, respectively labeled “1st” and “30th.” The sunrise time of the “1st” curve at the place where the solar altitude is 0 is about Beijing time 6:20. Then reason: Beijing time is East Eighth Zone time, that is, UTC+8. When the sun rises at this place on the 1st of this month, it is Beijing time 1st 6:20, which converted to Universal Time is the previous day 22:20. At this time, the meridian whose local time is 1st 0:00 is about 25°E, because from UTC previous day 22:20 to 1st 0:00 differs by 1 hour and 40 minutes, corresponding to a longitude difference of 25°. The range of the world that is on the 1st extends from 25°E eastward to the 180° meridian, about 155° of longitude. Its proportion of the world is about 155/360≈0.43, exceeding 1/3.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中纵轴为太阳高度，横轴为北京时间，曲线标有“1日”和“30日”；“1日”曲线在太阳高度为0处的日出时刻约标为北京时间6:20。再读题：要求该地该月1日日出这一瞬间，全球处于“1日”的范围比例。用北京时间为东八区时间这一桥梁，把1日6:20北京时间换算为世界时：UTC为前一日22:20。此时全球地方时为1日0:00的经线在25°E附近，1日范围从25°E向东到180°经线，约155°经度，占155/360≈0.43，因此约为大于1/3。
